mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate indicates monetary tightening coinciding with labor market weakness, compressing corporate profit margins and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts signals peak consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST declines in late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC for late-cycle signal falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production indicates manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rising federal funds rate signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs that depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises in tightening cycles, or Rank IC for tightening cycle signal remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production indicates broad-based slowdown in consumer demand and manufacturing output, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
